# LibreOffice Conversion Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.libreoffice` |
| Source | `09_docker/libreoffice.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, document |

Headless LibreOffice container used as a conversion worker for Office documents
in the ingestion pipeline. Built locally; idles waiting for work on /work.
